name: National MILO Marathon 2026 – National Finals
short_description: The National MILO Marathon 2026 National Finals is a full marathon event set for December 6, 2026, in Clark City, Pampanga, Philippines.
ai_summary: The National MILO Marathon 2026 National Finals is a full marathon event scheduled for December 6, 2026, in Clark City, Pampanga, Philippines. Organized by RUNRIO Inc., the race offers both a 21.1km half marathon and a 42.195km full marathon distance.
pros: The season-ending national final of the MILO Marathon series
Water every 1.5 to 2 km and 20 ambulances on standby in 2025
Fast front of the field: 2:27:58 won the 2025 marathon
Qualifiers race the marathon free, with prize money for the top three
cons: Marathon places only for runners who qualify at a regional leg
Six-hour limit with enforced checks at 21 km and 32 km
Night starts: 2am for the marathon in 2025
Overseas runners can take part but cannot win

faqs.question: Where is the race held?
faqs.answer: The National MILO Marathon 2026 National Finals takes place in Clark City, Pampanga, Philippines. This location serves as the venue for the event, which is organized by RUNRIO Inc. and includes both half marathon and full marathon distance categories for participants.

faqs.question: When is the race date?
faqs.answer: The race is scheduled for December 6, 2026. This date marks the National Finals of the MILO Marathon series, held in Clark City, Pampanga, Philippines, and organized by RUNRIO Inc., featuring both 21.1km and 42.195km distance options.

faqs.question: What distances are offered?
faqs.answer: Participants can choose between two distances: a 21.1km half marathon and a 42.195km full marathon. The full marathon distance of 42.195km is listed as the primary distance for this event, which is part of the National MILO Marathon 2026 National Finals.
